summary: SPACE MISSION is an interactive game that allows students to design, manage, and simulate a full space mission. Players make real engineering decisions, manage limited resources, and evaluate how each choice impacts mission success. Developed using Figma, the project transforms complex scientific concepts into an engaging and visually appealing learning experience. It's important because it promotes the study of astronomy through built-in quiz questions after each mission. Our project has an in-game achievement that gives motivation to players, to keep on going.
details: Developed using Figma, our game allows students to complete a full space mission with five levels, ranging from easy to hard. Each mission will be taken place in space or on the moon. For example, fixing space satellites or collecting moon samples. During the mission, players launch from Earth to space while collecting xp and coins along the way. During some missions, an unexpected malfunction will happen to the rocket and it is the players job to contact scientists on Earth to fix the malfunction. Ultimately, if the player hit too much asteroids or runs out of fuel their mission will fail and they will have to start again. After completing missions, an in-built quiz system helps students learn about astronomy such as "Why does Astronaut float on the moon?". If students get the question wrong, the system will show the real answer with the explanation. Not only that, players get to see what achievements they get such as finishing their first mission or finishing 50 missions. Players also unlock new stuff as they finish each level such as a new engine, fuel tank and new wings that helps their mission to go smoothly. Players also get new ranks based on how much xp they have collected during the mission. Last but not least, players can buy new skins using the coins that they achieve during the missions and they're able to save their progress to play later.
